reference.title: How does SMS device work?
reference.shortdesc: This section describes the functionality of an SMS device.

section.p: This section describes the functionality of an SMS device.
The hardware and software solution consists of the following components:

ul.li: Expert health monitoring software hosted on the ADI OtoSense™ Server
Mobile and web applications that allow customers to monitor the status of motors fitted with an SMS device

section.p: After an SMS device is configured and installed on a motor, it begins sending data to the ADI OtoSense™ Server. It begins a learning process during which the SMS device creates a unique, customized model of each motor. It measures the multi-axis vibration, magnetic field, and temperature conditions of the motor. With the help of this data, it detects critical motor anomalies and defects.

The SMS device can identify degradation that could lead to the following motor faults: power system, stator winding, rotor, motor shaft/balance, eccentricity, bearing, alignment, cooling system, loose foot, and overall motor performance.
